title: 30A Central Emerald Hill 21 Santa Rosa Beach, FL Stay at 30A Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Cozy Seagrove Beach Retreat!* Private Beach Access Just Steps Away * Private Patio with Poolside Location * Ground-Floor Unit-No stairs...
description_expanded: Overview5.0(3 reviews)Top Reasons to Book this Cozy Seagrove Beach Retreat!* Private Beach Access Just Steps Away * Private Patio with Poolside Location * Ground-Floor Unit-No stairs to hassle!* Steps to Seagrove Plaza and Close to Seaside and Rosemary Beach – Easily explore some of 30A's most popular communities* Near Family-Friendly State Parks * Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. * *We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates* Snowbird Season runs November thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!*Smart home technology is used to help ensure policy compliance and may include remotely monitored thermostats, door locks, a decibel meter, and video surveillance, including the front door.*Welcome to Emerald Hill 21, a charming ground-floor studio perfectly located in the heart of Seagrove Beach. Offering comfort, convenience, and easy access to the beach, this cozy retreat is an ideal choice for couples or small families looking to experience the best of 30A. When you're ready to relax, enjoy your own private patio, surrounded by peaceful tropical landscaping. It's the perfect spot for morning coffee, an afternoon break, or winding down after a day exploring the coast. Inside, the studio comfortably sleeps up to four guests with a Queen bed and sleeper sofa. The fully equipped kitchen provides everything you need to prepare easy meals and snacks, although you'll also be just steps from fantastic local restaurants and cafés. Whether you're spending your days on the beach, relaxing by the pool, exploring 30A, or enjoying a quiet evening on your private patio, Emerald Hill 21 is your cozy home base for a memorable Seagrove Beach getaway.The Bed Setup:Studio: Queen Bed +Sleeper SofaPlease Note: This home features a ventless dryer, which may take a bit longer to dry clothes than a traditional dryer. For best results, we recommend smaller loads.Area Attractions:Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World-style town center w/coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar-white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys Beach. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole. This laid-back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play, and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy!Show less
